answer: Each epoch a key buys its lantern with stake burned at its comet, and the nebula pools every comet under the founder that calibrated it — one calibration lineage, one pool. A pool's j-th lantern burns j × base per epoch, so k clones burn k(k+1)/2 × base every epoch, unsplit because the count follows the comet, not the wallet. A clone's own comet inherits its founder's pool, so freshness buys nothing; only an unrelated founder at base escapes, and each such founder locks a forfeitable calibration stake an operator must out-bribe. A newcomer calibrates once and lights at base.
